name: tolerance_fit
description: Compute hole and shaft deviation limits and fit type for a hole/shaft tolerance designation pair at a given nominal diameter, using ISO 286-1:2010 formulas and tables. Returns EI/ES for the hole, ei/es for the shaft, fit type (clearance/transition/interference), and clearance/interference extremes i

arguments.name: hole_code
arguments.desc: Hole tolerance designation. Only letter 'H' is supported (ISO hole-basis system). Use tolerance_fit_analyze for other hole letters (C, D, E, F, G, JS, K, M, N, P, R, S). Grade must be 1–18.

arguments.name: shaft_code
arguments.desc: Shaft tolerance designation, e.g. 'g6'. Supported letters: c, d, e, f, g, h, js, k, m, n, p, r, s, u. Grade must be 1–18.

arguments.name: nominal_diameter_mm
arguments.desc: Nominal diameter of the fit in mm, in the range (0, 500]. The engine selects the ISO 286-1 diameter range automatically.
